title: Public Pathway Consolidation v5r3: minimal public four-assay intersection
summary: A standalone, typed, life-level causal instrument for supported candidate selection, observable every-edge interleaved-response dependence, frozen DREAM context-policy value, and the total effect of DREAM-guided evidence-to-READ training. It uses a four-operation frozen policy, one isolated READ adapter, total statuses, exact paired inference, and inseparably non-mediational claims.
system_thesis: Experience Models should ultimately convert verified lived experience into prospective cognition. PPC5r3 does not test that flywheel. It tests four separately identified prerequisites while freezing THINK, DREAM, and ACT and restricting learning to candidate scoring. Success is only a non-mediational four-assay intersection; learned cognition, continual improvement, compression, parenting, populations, and scaling remain later hypotheses.

acceptance_tests.setup: Bind every normative/validator byte; two fresh interpretations, critique, proceed consensus, and exact architecture/scope ratification.
acceptance_tests.expected: All hashes, scope, semantics, and authority agree before implementation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust nominee-first eligibility, PROBE/future quarantine, exact equivalence, family-overlap reporting, D1A corpus, and zero-dose states.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only supported closed direct ACQUIRE rows enter authentic training; overlap strata are presealed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Writer sterility or support scope fails.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust all states, schedule phases, operations, parse/token/logical debit boundaries, errors, queues, event hashes, terminal and cold replay in two implementations.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every vector produces byte-identical typed receipts and replay.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Machine or receipt algebra is not total.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust DREAM request/result/status/debit/shared-lineage plus all context and root policy branches.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every result has one exact install/root/status/continuation mapping and no retry.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: DREAM policies are not total or shared.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust semantic table validity, forced scoring, quantization/ties, empty/missing, common response, direct D1A requests, and descriptive providers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Portable full-table selections and response bytes match in two implementations.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: D1A provider interface or selection is ambiguous.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust adapter isolation, recipient-disjoint donor matching/failure, matched-binding perfect derangement, dose parity, corpus-hash divergence, and forbidden mounts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only typed READ scoring changes; controls are prospective and causally distinct.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Specificity controls or adapter isolation fail.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust alias maps, finite-world sufficiency, unique paths, subsets, alternatives, source hashes, twin/sham construction, parity and proof objects.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only source-disjoint minimal decisive 2/3-edge items construct identically.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Path instrument is not independently constructible.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exhaust AUTHENTIC, every-edge CUT/TWIN, SHAM, ONE_SHOT_READ, OPEN_LOOP, exact intervention matching, wrong/extra/missing operations, queue flush and opacity.
acceptance_tests.expected: Schedule timing and response identity vary only at registered boundaries; every mismatch remains ITT or RUN_INVALID as declared.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cross every DREAM status with authentic, recency, and permuted context installation under the D1C freeze matrix.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only installed context differs; cardinality/focus/token/failure are registered treatment components.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: D1C is confounded or not total.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cross every DREAM/projection/writer/trainer/publication status with all root policies under the D1D freeze matrix.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only root-policy assignment and induced downstream consequences differ; no matching/fallback.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: D1D total-policy estimand is not identified.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two reducers exhaust statuses, adverse bounds, exact paired randomization, all gates, per-edge conjunction, Holm ties/boundaries, zero eligibility, missing limits, resources, power fixtures, and release bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Identical observations, p-values, intervals, assay/Holm/blocker states, power decisions, resources, and literal strings.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Scientific estimand or release can drift after outcomes.

acceptance_tests.setup: Cross all 11 information classes with all 14 stages; run field mutation/taint tests and every authority/preflight transition.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only allowlisted projections influence exact stages; premature dispatch is unreachable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Visibility or authority firewall is incomplete.

acceptance_tests.setup: Two independent no-model implementations seal manifests, paths, interventions, assignments, donors, matrices, reducers, resources, power, and populated run-lock inputs.
acceptance_tests.expected: All construction and analysis hashes agree; fresh review passes; separate run authority still required.

acceptance_tests.setup: Under later exact run authority, canary, runtime perturbations, all assigned controls, postrun replay/reduction, resource audit, and literal claim audit.
acceptance_tests.expected: No integrity leak; claims emit only through the exact map after all global and local gates.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Runtime evidence differs from sealed design or overclaims.

human_boundary.decision_question: After a fresh proceed consensus, do you ratify these exact PPC5r3 architecture bytes and the exact proposal-only CPU/no-model implementation scope, while leaving every model, tokenizer, embedding, training, behavioral, canary, GPU, and scientific action forbidden until a separate reviewed run lock and exact run ratification?
